payload.claim: The spec declares risk: standard, but criteria 1 and 3 touch saffron/gates/core/witness.py, which matches elevate_on: saffron/gates/** in .saffron/policy.yaml. Per saffron/repos/policy.py's effective_risk, the task's effective risk tier will be computed as elevated regardless of the declared field, making the size gate blocking rather than advisory. This matches the repo's own precedent (the dependency SA-0351, this exact base commit, does the same), and the small estimated_lines: 53 makes the elevated size ceiling unlikely to bind, so this is informational only.
